expectations.evidence: Lists all five Tier 1 projects: DevPlanner, LMApi, LMEval, MemoryApi, and SourceManager, each with detailed descriptions organized by architectural layer.
States 'LMEval is the critical path' and it's 'explicitly marked as the #1 priority'. Explains it unblocks measurable improvement across everything else.
States MemoryApi is 'blocked on LMEval — the prompt quality for its AI features needs measurable refinement, which requires LMEval to be further along'.
Describes 'self-refining, local-first AI development stack' with philosophy of 'local hardware, full control, measurable quality, no vendor lock-in'.
PiDog projects listed under 'Application Layer' without being highlighted as priorities. Not mentioned in the priority list.
